name: web-plus-minus-accordion-tabs-with-bordered-rows
title: Bordered FAQ rows with plus and minus icons; the open row shows a short grey answer
whatItIs: A white component 'Tabs w/ plus-minus' with four separate rounded bordered rows of bold questions; three show a plus at the right and the third is open with a minus and a two-line grey answer.
whatItMeans: Clean and legible; plus and minus icons make expandability instantly clear.
techniques: Separate each item in its own bordered card.
Use plus and minus instead of chevrons.
Show answers in grey under the question.

vocabulary.definition: An icon that switches between plus and minus.
A row inside its own thin border.
Grey supporting text shown when open.
An accordion whose items are separate cards.
